basis: Current implementation review and the explicitly described local fixture; not an acceptance report.

items.finding: Server handlers, encrypted existing-session bridge, ES256 signer, canonical Supabase adapter, actual PostgreSQL RPCs and public account restoration/recovery/deletion-status recovery are implemented and locally tested. The combined server/SQL/client regression passed 339 tests; account browser fixtures passed 15 scenarios. A draft Cloudflare host adapter and explicit public-only authority build input exist. Real payment acquisition is unfinished: the Worker does not provide a payment verifier and there is no checkout-start route. Credentials alone do not complete that adapter.
items.requiredResolution: Reuse the canonical backend and account identity, implement and test the server contracts and denial/revocation/deletion behavior, then validate concrete merchant and signing authority evidence. Do not create a second account database.
items.doesNotClaim: A loopback QA identity or locally signed fixture is not a real purchase or a verified production merchant integration.

items.doesNotClaim: Existing interface strings reused in startup shells do not approve all English content or newly authored legal/purchase text.

items.finding: The saved account subject and signed receipt use localStorage on the same origin as the public site. Path and cache namespaces are cooperative isolation, not a separate origin or hardware identity. Offline verification cannot observe new remote revocations; browser storage is not guaranteed durable.
items.requiredResolution: Assess the concrete production origin/session model, test denial and subject changes, document storage loss and bounded offline rights, and verify deployment controls. Do not promise hardware device binding or immediate offline revocation.
items.doesNotClaim: Signature verification does not protect against compromised same-origin script or establish a trusted clock across reloads.

items.finding: The builder captures exact Rollup source ownership after Vite finalizes bytes and checks disk SHA. The static artifact auditor verifies internal consistency and current source hashes, but an independently reproduced coordinated sidecar/hash rewrite can reassign a source lacking a direct Vite key and omit its true lazy chunk from bootstrap without a finding.
items.requiredResolution: Before claiming exact-candidate source-to-output provenance, compare against an explicitly trusted external build receipt captured from the finalized compiler output or independently repeat the compilation and compare exact ownership. Continue actual cold-offline tests of the built artifact.
items.doesNotClaim: This limitation is not evidence that the current locally built mapping is false; the preparation auditor does not establish arbitrary executable equivalence.
